program: Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Graduate Program (BISB)

requirements.quote: Candidates should have a quantitative or computational track record

You should also take math and biology courses at your school, similar to these UCSD undergraduate classes: UCSD # Title Math 20A-B-C-D Calculus and Introduction to Differential Equations Math 18 Linear Algebra Math 11 , 183 , or 186 Introduction to Probability and Statistics

CSE 6R or 11 Introduction to Computer Science and Object-Oriented Programming ( CSE 6R: Python or CSE 11: Java ) CSE 12 Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design CSE 20 / Math 15A Discrete Mathematics

Beyond introductory programming and scripting courses, it is essential to have taken undergraduate courses in data structures and algorithms prior to taking the required BISB class CSE 282 / BENG 202 (Introduction to Bioinformatics Algorithms).
